subject.title: fix(agents): wake top-level requester when its last parallel child settles

question: After the delete-cleanup gap is fixed, should OpenClaw accept this bounded top-level requester settle wake and retry semantics as the canonical sessions_yield fan-out backstop?
rationale: The code repair is concrete, but adding automatic post-drain requester turns and retry attempts is a runtime/message-delivery policy choice that green tests cannot fully settle.

options.title: Accept Bounded Runtime Wake
options.body: Repair cleanup=delete handling, keep the three-attempt retry design, and treat the runtime wake as the canonical backstop for top-level fan-outs.

options.title: Limit The Wake Scope
options.body: Document and enforce a narrower supported scope such as keep/suspended completion flows, leaving delete-mode fan-outs outside this PR.

options.title: Choose Different Orchestration Semantics
options.body: Pause this branch and design a different parent-completion contract before adding automatic top-level requester turns.

recommendation.title: Accept Bounded Runtime Wake
recommendation.body: Repair cleanup=delete handling, keep the three-attempt retry design, and treat the runtime wake as the canonical backstop for top-level fan-outs.
